meta.title: Lingo - In-Game Chat Translation Client | Type in your language, the whole team reads it
meta.description: Lingo is an AI in-game chat translation client for Windows and macOS. Type normally in the chat box, press one hotkey, and the translation replaces your text in place. Built-in glossaries for Dota 2, League of Legends, Overwatch and World of Warcraft, 9 languages, no login and no API setup.
meta.keywords: game chat translation, in-game translator, AI game translator, hotkey translation, Dota 2 translator, League of Legends translator, Overwatch translator, World of Warcraft translator, team chat translation, game glossary

highlights.title:
A new client,
redesigned around one translation.
highlights.subtitle: 1.0.0 rebuilds the interface, the brand and the flow together: a dark-first Arena HUD design language, a new mark, and a home screen centred on a live demo.

items.title: Dark-first interface
items.desc: One azure token set shared with the new logo. Game, language direction and hotkey sit in a single bottom bar, and a light theme is one click away in the sidebar.

items.title: Click-to-record hotkey
items.desc: No more multi-step setup: click, press the combination, done. The style page now types out a live preview of each output style.

items.title: A tutorial you can replay
items.desc: One button plays the whole flow: type, hotkey, replace, Enter. UI fonts ship inside the app instead of loading from the network.

highlights.screenshotAlt: Screenshot of the Lingo 1.0.0 client home screen

features.title:
One hotkey.
The shortest path to being understood.
features.subtitle: Lingo is not a general-purpose translator. It is a hotkey-first workflow built for in-game team chat: copy, translate and fill back in one motion.

hotkey.title: Hotkey translation, replaced in place
hotkey.desc: Press the hotkey and Lingo reads the chat box, sends it to server-side AI, and writes the translation back where it was. It never sends for you; you still review and hit Enter.

glossary.title: A glossary that knows the game
glossary.desc: 1,340 official hero, item and ability names plus 100 player aliases. Calls like BKB, smoke or rosh keep their meaning instead of being translated word for word.

styles.title: Three output styles
styles.desc: Normal, Pro and Toxic. Switch with one click; the next translation uses it immediately.

phrases.title: Phrase hotkeys
phrases.desc: Up to {{max}} high-frequency calls, each on its own shortcut. Matches fill instantly without a cloud call.

languages.title: 9 languages, any direction
languages.desc: When both sides match, Lingo polishes your line in the selected style instead.

zeroSetup.title: Works out of the box
zeroSetup.desc: Models and routing are managed server-side: no account, no API key. In-app updates on both Windows and macOS.

safe.title: Never touches the game process
safe.desc: Lingo only uses the OS clipboard and keyboard events. It does not inject into the game and never sends messages on its own.

styles.title: One line, three ways to say it.
styles.subtitle: Choose how the translation should sound. Click a card to switch; the preview below types out the result.

auto.title: Normal
auto.desc: Natural, steady and easy to understand, like a normal teammate speaking clearly.

pro.title: Pro
pro.desc: Denser terminology and shorter, harder calls for coordinated team play.

toxic.title: Toxic
toxic.tag: Use with care · may get reported
toxic.desc: Sharper and more confrontational for pressure and tempo, while staying in-game usable.
toxic.out: this trash jungler never ganks lmao
toxic.preview: jungler, mid is free, wake up lmao

howItWorks.title: Three steps. Never leave the game.
howItWorks.subtitle: Type → press the hotkey → the translation replaces your text. The cursor never leaves the chat box.

steps.title: Type in the game chat
steps.desc: Enter the message normally and keep focus in the current input.

steps.title: Press the translation hotkey
steps.desc: Default ⌘+T on macOS or Alt+T on Windows, re-recordable in one click. Lingo reads the input and creates the target-language text.

steps.title: The translation replaces the original
steps.desc: The target-language line replaces your text. Review it, then press Enter yourself.

safety.title: Does not interfere with anti-cheat
safety.desc: Lingo only uses the OS clipboard and keyboard events. It does not inject into the game process or send messages automatically.

games.title:
Glossaries for four games.
Works in any other.
games.subtitle: Pick your game in the client and translations use that game’s official names and player slang. Choose “Other game” and no game-specific terms are injected, which fits any multiplayer game with text chat.

dota2.name: Dota 2
dota2.desc: Smoke, BKB, retreat and fight calls come out the way players actually say them.

lol.name: League of Legends
lol.desc: Lane, jungle, objective and focus calls phrased the way teammates expect.
lol.terms: 738 official names · 173 champions · 543 items · 22 summoner spells

overwatch.name: Overwatch
overwatch.desc: Position, focus, regroup and push calls stay short enough for quick chat.

wow.name: World of Warcraft
wow.desc: Clean up raid, party and regroup messages before sending them to the group.

other.name: Other games
other.desc: Generic mode: no game-specific glossary, but negation, numbers, timings and targets are always preserved. Works in any game with text chat.

download.title:
Get Lingo 1.0
for your next match.
download.subtitle: Official installers are served from our Tencent Cloud mirror and download quickly worldwide. After installing, the client checks for and installs updates in-app.

windows.title: Windows
windows.requirement: Requires the WebView2 Runtime (built into Windows 11).

macos.title: macOS
macos.requirement: On first launch, grant Accessibility permission in System Settings.

notes: New: a dark interface and brand mark. The home screen centres on a live translation demo, with game, languages and hotkey in one bottom bar, and a light theme in the sidebar.
Improved: click-to-record hotkeys, a live preview on the translation style page, a one-click tutorial playback, and UI fonts bundled with the app instead of loaded from the network.
Fixed: the home screen no longer shows the unreleased incoming-chat translation settings.
